title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the final pressure magnitude as 500 N (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Conservation of energy
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply energy conservation to relate the height at the highest point to the speed at the lowest point, correctly using the geometry (e.g., l(1-cosθ)).

title: Newton's second law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law at the lowest point, setting up the equation for centripetal force (F_N - mg = mv²/l).

title: Newton's third law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly invoke Newton's third law to equate the normal force from the board on the child to the pressure exerted by the child on the board.

title: Correct geometry/height
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the vertical drop from the highest to the lowest point as l(1 - cos60°).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All calculations should maintain consistent units (kg, m, s, N) throughout.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the centripetal force equation is incorrectly written (e.g., mg - F_N = mv²/l or missing the minus sign).

title: Incorrect energy term
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the potential energy change is miscalculated (e.g., using l*cosθ or l*sinθ for the height difference).
